name: WorkspaceSettingsV2
description: APIs to manage workspace level settings

methods.name: GetPublicWorkspaceSetting
methods.description: Get a setting value at workspace level. See :method:settingsv2/listworkspacesettingsmetadata for list of setting available via public APIs.

all_fields.name: name
all_fields.description: Name of the setting

methods.name: ListWorkspaceSettingsMetadata
methods.description:
List valid setting keys and metadata. These settings are available to be referenced via
GET :method:settingsv2/getpublicworkspacesetting and
PATCH :method:settingsv2/patchpublicworkspacesetting APIs
methods.summary: List valid setting keys and their metadata.

all_fields.name: page_size
all_fields.description:
The maximum number of settings to return. The service may return fewer than this value.
If unspecified, at most 200 settings will be returned.
The maximum value is 1000; values above 1000 will be coerced to 1000.

all_fields.name: page_token
all_fields.description:
A page token, received from a previous `ListWorkspaceSettingsMetadataRequest` call.
Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

When paginating, all other parameters provided to `ListWorkspaceSettingsMetadataRequest` must match
the call that provided the page token.

poll_field.name: page_token
poll_field.description:
A page token, received from a previous `ListWorkspaceSettingsMetadataRequest` call.
Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

When paginating, all other parameters provided to `ListWorkspaceSettingsMetadataRequest` must match
the call that provided the page token.

methods.name: PatchPublicWorkspaceSetting
methods.description:
Patch a setting value at workspace level. See :method:settingsv2/listworkspacesettingsmetadata for list of setting available via public APIs at workspace level.
To determine the correct field to include in a patch request, refer to the type field of the setting returned in the :method:settingsv2/listworkspacesettingsmetadata response.

Note: Page refresh is required for changes to take effect in UI.
